faq.q: What is the origin of Necla?
faq.a: Necla is associated with Arabic. Necla is the Turkish form of Arabic نَجْلَة (Najla), associated with the sense 'offspring, noble'.
Yes — the underlying form نَجْلَة is Arabic.
Necla can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Necla should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Najla is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Necla mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Necla is rendered نجلہ and carries the sense نجلہ، اولاد.

faq.q: What does Necla mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Necla is rendered نجله and carries the sense نجله، فرزند.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Necla, necla. Script forms are نجله, نجلہ, نَجْلَة, नजला.

faq.q: Is Necla a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
